description: agentbbs Phase 2 — pin a remote federation peer by nodeId, URL and Ed25519 public key. The key is pinned at add time and every envelope merged from this peer is verified against it, so a hostile peer cannot forge another node's envelopes. Re-adding a known nodeId with a different key is refused; remove it first. Max 256 peers. Use when you have a peer's identity out of band and want to start syncing with it. Trusting a key carried inside an incoming envelope is wrong because that only proves the sender holds some key, not that they are the node they claim to be.
name: federation_bbs_peer_add
